source.name: About FIBA: "FIBA extends partnership with Junckers to provide best-in-class hardwood sports flooring until 2028"
source.quote: Junckers selected as the Official Technical Supplier for four more years to provide high-performance hardwood floors for FIBA's global events.

note: FIBA's Official Technical Supplier of hardwood floors, extended through 2028: an equipment supply deal, not a sponsorship.
